question: Veteran Dance guru, Jatin Goswami was awarded with the Kalidas Samman for his significant contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• KALIDAS SAMMAN was given to Kathak artist/master** Uma Sharma and Sattriya** artist/master Jatin Goswami for the year** 2017 and 2018 on Feb 20, 2020 **on the initial night of the Khajuraho Dance Festival.
 
• **Jatin Goswami **is an Indian artist and choreographer, known as one of the unmistakable examples of the traditional dance type of Sattriya.
 
• The Government of India granted him the non military personnel distinction of the **Padma Shri, in 2008.**
 
• He is likewise a beneficiary of praises like Bharatiyam Samman of the Department of **Tourism and Culture, Silpi Divas Award (1994), Sangeet Jyoti Award (2004).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Deodhani dance **is a Shaman society dance from the Indian province of Assam. It tends to be performed either solo or in a gathering.
 
• Chhau dance, likewise spelled Chhou dance, is a semi old style Indian hit the dance floor with military and people customs.
 
• The Bagurumba is a customary dance of the native** Boro** individuals living in the State of Assam and North East India.
 
• **Jatin Goswami **is an Indian dancer and choreographer, known as one of the prominent exponents of the classical dance form of **Sattriya.**
